description: This source file defines the HiveMqtt3PublisherActor class, an actor responsible for publishing messages to an MQTT broker using HiveMQ's MQTT 3 client. It includes methods for creating publisher actors, mapping external messages to MQTT publish messages, and extracting topic and payload information from messages.

classes.name: HiveMqtt3PublisherActor
classes.description: An actor class responsible for publishing MQTT messages using HiveMQ's MQTT 3 client. It provides methods to create publisher instances, convert external messages to MQTT publish messages, and extract message details such as topic and payload.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Static method to create a Props object for actor creation with specified connection, client, and dryRun flag.

methods.name: mapExternalMessageToMqttMessage
methods.description: Converts an ExternalMessage into an Mqtt3Publish message, determining the payload based on message type (text or bytes).

methods.name: getTopic
methods.description: Retrieves the topic string from an Mqtt3Publish message.

methods.name: getPayload
methods.description: Retrieves the payload ByteBuffer from an Mqtt3Publish message, if available.
